notifications.title: Fresh New Look & Crash Fix
notifications.message: Android users: fixed a crash that could close the app after pausing a station whose stream had dropped. Update to v1.7 from the Play Store. Also new: Recently played and Favourites rows on Home, station logos shown in full, a header that takes on the colour of the station you're playing, and a LIVE badge in the player. The station list loads instantly from cache and scrolls more smoothly, light mode is fixed, and play buttons are always visible on touch screens.

notifications.title: Background Playback Fixed
notifications.message: Android users: radio streams now keep playing when your screen turns off or you switch apps. Update to v1.2 from the Play Store to get the fix.

notifications.title: Set a Favourite Country
notifications.message: Open By Country in the sidebar and tap the star next to any country to make it your default. RadioAjay will load that country's stations every time you open the app.

notifications.title: RadioAjay Updated
notifications.message: New in this release: automatic CarPlay & Android Auto detection, vibrant new logo, improved mobile layout with full-height country/genre lists, always-visible favourite heart, and more.
